corrections.reason: Maintained Alpha/alpha is အဲလ်ဖာ. Author proposal silently overrides that established core.
Use maintained Alpha core အဲလ်ဖာ in the new whole Plan Alpha compound.
Reconcile Plan Alpha across both covert-operation fields with maintained Alpha core အဲလ်ဖာ.

English refers to the Fey Dragon Scale item. Retain the whole identifying phrase at first occurrence, using the same compound pronunciation as this quest objective rather than splitting off scale semantically.

Clarify that the courier lost her life, so the supplies honor her death. The existing phrase can read as something she lost and obscures the referent. Current source body/death context and UA complete explicitly support this meaning.

The source says forces dwindle while reclaiming land. နည်းနည်း is the adverb a little; နည်းနည်းလာတယ် is awkward here and weakens the clear progressive decrease. နည်းပါးလာတယ် naturally expresses dwindling force strength while preserving Morbin's voice and all surrounding meaning.
Source lightning struck the ground from time to time means intermittent/occasional strikes. မကြာခဏ means frequently and increases the stated frequency; အခါအားလျော်စွာ retains source timing.

English refers to a rod used for reconstruction/re-enchantment/transformation, not a spear. လှံတံ denotes a spear/shaft and unnecessarily introduces a weapon sense. Replace each generic rod mention in this field with neutral တုတ်တံ. Keep named English Dartol identities and their maintained/new proposed phonetics unchanged. Assisted semantic correction; native wording certification remains pending.
